regions.text: Select units, then click Hold. They move to nearby protective cover and stay there. They aim and fire automatically.
regions.title: HOLD

regions.text: Select units, then click Push. Move the pointer left or right to place an advance line on the map, then left-click to confirm. Units advance using cover and resume fighting on their own when they reach their positions. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the line.
regions.title: PUSH

regions.text: Select units, then click Fall Back. Move the pointer left or right to place a retreat line, then left-click to confirm. Units seek cover on your side of the line and hold there. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the line.
regions.title: FALL BACK

regions.text: Select units, then click Clear Orders to remove their movement, cover and target orders. They return to fighting on their own.
regions.title: CLEAR ORDERS

regions.text: Pause the fight to inspect units and give orders. Press Space to pause or resume; choose a speed button to resume at that speed.
regions.title: PAUSE

regions.text: Run the fight at half speed. You can still select units and give orders.
regions.title: SLOW MOTION

regions.text: Resume the fight at normal speed.
regions.title: NORMAL SPEED

regions.text: Run the fight at one and a half times normal speed.
regions.title: FAST FORWARD

regions.text: Show or hide faction emblems above units. The highlighted emblem marks a selected unit.
regions.title: EMBLEMS

regions.text: Turn battle audio on or off.
regions.title: AUDIO

regions.text: Active counts your living units, including wounded units. Eliminated counts units you have lost. Their cards remain in the roster.
regions.title: YOUR ROSTER

regions.text: This is the faction you command. The unit cards below belong to your side.
regions.title: YOUR FACTION

regions.text: Look for this emblem above units to recognize your side.
regions.title: YOUR EMBLEM

regions.text: Compare the two forces here. Advantage, Even or Disadvantage gives a quick strength comparison; it does not guarantee the outcome.
regions.title: RELATIVE STRENGTH

regions.text: Green is your side's share of the strength comparison; red is the enemy's share. More green means a stronger position.
regions.title: STRENGTH BAR

regions.text: Check this message when an order cannot be carried out. A unit may be wounded, a cover position may be occupied, or no suitable route or protective position may be available.
regions.title: ORDER FEEDBACK

regions.text: Click a card to select that unit. Shift-click to add or remove it from your selection. Highlighted cards are selected. Eliminated units cannot receive orders.
regions.title: UNIT CARD

regions.text: This picture identifies the unit. Click its card to select it; Shift-click to change a group selection.
regions.title: UNIT PORTRAIT

regions.text: This symbol identifies the unit's weapon class. Use the matching class button above to select units with that class.
regions.title: WEAPON CLASS

regions.text: The unit's weapon class. Units aim, fire and reload automatically while following your orders.
regions.title: WEAPON CLASS

regions.text: The weapon this unit is carrying. Its weapon affects how it fights, including range and rate of fire.
regions.title: EQUIPPED WEAPON

regions.text: T is the unit's tier. The number after it identifies this unit in your roster. Unit tier and weapon tier are separate.
regions.title: TIER AND UNIT NUMBER

regions.text: The percentage shows remaining health. Wounded units prioritize survival and cannot follow new combat orders. Eliminated units are out of the fight.
regions.title: HEALTH AND STATUS

regions.text: The bar shrinks as this unit loses health. Yellow indicates a wounded unit; an empty bar means the unit is eliminated.
regions.title: HEALTH BAR

regions.text: Holding, Pushing or Falling Back shows this unit's current group order. Choose another order to replace it, or use Clear Orders.
